question: Three of the following figures are alike in a certain way and one is different. Which one is different?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334ffe442b2bcd48a44fd00faa58f4843b7a9d1e3d2a079745c8df843e5e62a7.png] → Out of all the triangles, two are flipped vertically. 

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f281a77875122a7cc5289fee0b1b6ba79da6a62fadac0d0778b46044189ef2da.png] → Out of all the triangles, two are flipped vertically.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/915bc6d90ef9088f2bc6307bde16a6cd6e52504f72c779c4dc6c8c3a273c742b.png] →** No triangles**** are flipped vertically. **

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48a3de03da52096a728ce689711b77cc86f36b023475cf5fb016ca316144dc3a.png] → Out of all the triangles, two are flipped vertically. 

Thus, out of all the options figure option 3 is the odd one out.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
